# Thunderbird (115 and later) writing back: an edit, a conflict, a
# completion, a create and a delete. Written from published client
# behaviour, not captured traffic: Thunderbird's calendar provider sends the
# whole object as it read it, with the properties it did not change, adds
# X-MOZ-GENERATION and X-MOZ-LASTACK, sends If-Match on every change and
# If-None-Match: * on a create, offers overwrite or discard on 412, writes
# PERCENT-COMPLETE:100 and COMPLETED with a tick, and fetches the object
# again after a PUT answered without an ETag. Thunderbird writes DAV: as D:.

### the tags tix shows are set in the browser
DO tag open1

### the ETags at depth 1
PROPFIND {infra}
Depth: 1

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<D:propfind xmlns:D="DAV:"><D:prop><D:getetag/><D:current-user-privilege-set/></D:prop></D:propfind>
EXPECT 207
PROP {infra} {DAV:}current-user-privilege-set 200 <d:bind/>
SAVE etag1 {infra}{open1}.ics {DAV:}getetag

### editing the summary sends the whole object back
PUT {infra}{open1}.ics
Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
If-Match: {etag1}

BEGIN:VCALENDAR
PRODID:-//Mozilla.org/NONSGML Mozilla Calendar V1.1//EN
VERSION:2.0
BEGIN:VTODO
UID:task-{open1}@tix
CREATED:20260101T000000Z
LAST-MODIFIED:20260101T090000Z
DTSTAMP:20260101T090000Z
SEQUENCE:2
SUMMARY:Rotate keys with ops
STATUS:NEEDS-ACTION
PRIORITY:0
CATEGORIES:ops,security
X-TIX-REF:INFRA-1
X-TIX-STATE:todo
X-MOZ-GENERATION:1
END:VTODO
END:VCALENDAR
EXPECT 204
TASK open1 title Rotate keys with ops
TASK open1 tags ops,security

### the object fetched again carries Thunderbird's generation
GET {infra}{open1}.ics

EXPECT 200
HAS X-MOZ-GENERATION:1
SAVEHEADER etag2 ETag

### the task is renamed in the browser
DO retitle open1

### Thunderbird's next edit is a conflict
PUT {infra}{open1}.ics
Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
If-Match: {etag2}

BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
BEGIN:VTODO
UID:task-{open1}@tix
SUMMARY:Thunderbird's version
X-MOZ-GENERATION:2
END:VTODO
END:VCALENDAR
EXPECT 412
TASK open1 title Rotate keys (edited)

### discard: the object is fetched again
GET {infra}{open1}.ics

EXPECT 200
HAS SUMMARY:Rotate keys (edited)
SAVEHEADER etag3 ETag

### ticking the task off
PUT {infra}{open1}.ics
Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
If-Match: {etag3}

BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
BEGIN:VTODO
UID:task-{open1}@tix
SUMMARY:Rotate keys (edited)
STATUS:COMPLETED
COMPLETED:20260101T100000Z
PERCENT-COMPLETE:100
CATEGORIES:ops,security
X-MOZ-GENERATION:3
END:VTODO
END:VCALENDAR
EXPECT 204
TASK open1 status done

### a new task with an alarm
PUT {infra}a2d5c1f0-7b4e-4c8e-9d3a-1f2e3d4c5b6a.ics
Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
If-None-Match: *

BEGIN:VCALENDAR
PRODID:-//Mozilla.org/NONSGML Mozilla Calendar V1.1//EN
VERSION:2.0
BEGIN:VTIMEZONE
TZID:Europe/Berlin
BEGIN:STANDARD
TZOFFSETFROM:+0200
TZOFFSETTO:+0100
TZNAME:CET
DTSTART:19701025T030000
RRULE:FREQ=YEARLY;BYDAY=-1SU;BYMONTH=10
END:STANDARD
BEGIN:DAYLIGHT
TZOFFSETFROM:+0100
TZOFFSETTO:+0200
TZNAME:CEST
DTSTART:19700329T020000
RRULE:FREQ=YEARLY;BYDAY=-1SU;BYMONTH=3
END:DAYLIGHT
END:VTIMEZONE
BEGIN:VTODO
CREATED:20260101T100000Z
LAST-MODIFIED:20260101T100000Z
DTSTAMP:20260101T100000Z
UID:a2d5c1f0-7b4e-4c8e-9d3a-1f2e3d4c5b6a
SUMMARY:Renew the certificate
DTSTART;TZID=Europe/Berlin:20260101T110000
DUE;TZID=Europe/Berlin:20260120T170000
PRIORITY:1
X-MOZ-GENERATION:1
BEGIN:VALARM
ACTION:DISPLAY
TRIGGER;RELATED=END:-PT15M
DESCRIPTION:Default Mozilla Description
END:VALARM
END:VTODO
END:VCALENDAR
EXPECT 201
TASK Renew_the_certificate due 2026-01-20T16:00Z
TASK Renew_the_certificate snoozed 2026-01-01T10:00Z

### the new task's object keeps the alarm
GET {infra}a2d5c1f0-7b4e-4c8e-9d3a-1f2e3d4c5b6a.ics

EXPECT 200
HAS UID:a2d5c1f0-7b4e-4c8e-9d3a-1f2e3d4c5b6a
HAS TRIGGER;RELATED=END:-PT15M
HAS PRIORITY:1

### deleting the other task cancels it
DELETE {infra}{open2}.ics
If-Match: *

EXPECT 204
TASK open2 status cancelled
TASK open2 trashed false
